services.name: Charter Day
services.desc: We try to keep the planning of your charter as seamless and pleasant as possible. Here is what you can expect throughout all phases of the booking process. To secure your charter, submit an inquiry form on the 'book' tab of this site. This will tell us everything we need to know - your group size & what sports and activities we should prepare for your charter. Once we schedule a date, your booking is confirmed. We will be available to answer any questions or concerns you may have, & plan any special requests for your group.
